title: Evolver: Turning Agent Exploration into Evolving Capabilities
title_zh: Evolver：将智能体探索转化为不断进化的能力

paragraphs.en: Agent exploration produces valuable procedural knowledge, yet much of this experience remains confined to transient execution traces and is not systematically reused. We introduce Evolver , an experience-driven framework that transforms agent exploration into persistent, reusable capabilities without updating foundation model parameters. Built around structured Gene assets, Evolver integrates experience acquisition, retrieval, and feedback-guided evolution to support experience-conditioned execution across existing agent harnesses. We evaluate Evolver using Claude Code and Codex, two foundation model configurations, and four benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 2.1, SWE-bench Multilingual, SWE-rebench, and GAIA. On a selected diagnostic set of 320 paired executions, Evolver improves task success from 83.13% to 87.50% (+4.38 percentage points) while reducing recorded task-execution token consumption by 24.24%. Furthermore, among 265 pairs successful under both conditions, token consumption decreases by 17.57%, demonstrating efficiency benefits even when task success is preserved. These findings suggest that persistent procedural experience can improve both task effectiveness and execution efficiency, providing a practical foundation for transforming agent exploration into evolving capabilities.

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents have progressed from language generation to multi-step problem solving through tool use and environmental interaction, with growing applications in software engineering and other complex tasks [ 1 , 2 ] . Executing these tasks often requires extensive environment exploration, tool invocation, failure recovery, and outcome verification, incurring substantial computational and interaction costs. Yet the procedural knowledge acquired through these interactions is often confined to individual executions, leaving subsequent tasks to rediscover useful strategies and repeat similar exploratory efforts. This raises a fundamental question: How can the computational effort invested in past exploration be transformed into reusable experience that continuously improves future agent capabilities?
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体已从语言生成发展到通过工具使用和环境交互进行多步问题求解，在软件工程及其他复杂任务中的应用日益增多 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 执行这些任务往往需要大量的环境探索、工具调用、失败恢复和结果验证，从而产生可观的计算与交互成本。 然而，通过这些交互获得的程序性知识往往局限于单次执行，导致后续任务需要重新发现有用的策略并重复类似的探索工作。 这引出了一个根本性问题：如何将过去探索中投入的计算精力转化为可复用的经验，从而持续提升智能体的未来能力？

paragraphs.en: Recent coding agents, such as Codex [ 3 ] and Claude Code [ 4 ] , have demonstrated the growing potential of autonomous software development. Meanwhile, Skill -based approaches enable agents to reuse packaged instructions, workflows, and domain-specific resources [ 5 ] , while other methods leverage historical trajectories, execution feedback, and evolving contexts to improve agent behavior without updating model parameters [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . More recently, research on strategy genes has shown that compact, control-oriented Gene representations can provide more effective experience reuse and iterative refinement than documentation-oriented Skill representations in controlled scientific coding settings [ 9 ] . Despite these advances, a central systems challenge remains: how to transform task-specific exploration into persistent, reusable strategy assets that can be integrated with existing agents and progressively refined through execution feedback. Moreover, accumulating experience does not necessarily improve performance, as irrelevant or outdated strategies may introduce redundant computation or interfere with otherwise successful executions.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的一些编码智能体，例如 Codex [ 3 ] 和 Claude Code [ 4 ] ，展示了自主软件开发的巨大潜力。 与此同时，基于 Skill 的方法使智能体能够复用打包好的指令、工作流和领域特定资源 [ 5 ] ，而其他方法则利用历史轨迹、执行反馈和不断演化的上下文来改进智能体行为，且无需更新模型参数 [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] 。 最近，关于策略基因的研究表明，在受控的科学编码场景中，紧凑且面向控制的 Gene 表示相比面向文档的 Skill 表示能够提供更有效的经验复用和迭代优化 [ 9 ] 。 尽管取得了这些进展，一个核心的系统性挑战仍然存在：如何将特定任务的探索转化为持久的、可复用的策略资产，使其能够与现有智能体集成，并通过执行反馈逐步优化。 此外，积累经验并不一定会提升性能，因为不相关或过时的策略可能引入冗余计算，或干扰原本成功的执行过程。

paragraphs.en: To address this challenge, we introduce Evolver , an experience-driven agent evolution system built around the principle of Exploration-to-Evolution : transforming knowledge acquired through task execution into persistent strategy assets that can guide subsequent decisions and support iterative adaptation. Building on the Gene representation, Evolver encodes reusable procedures and their applicability conditions as structured Gene objects, associates them with concrete execution cases through Capsules, and maintains event, provenance, and review records to support experience management. Through integration with existing agent harnesses, Evolver makes historical experience available during subsequent task execution without modifying the underlying model parameters. Rather than treating execution histories as passive records, Evolver organizes procedural knowledge into reusable assets that can be selected, applied, and maintained in response to new execution feedback. This design establishes a mechanism through which previously invested exploration can contribute to future agent behavior, providing a foundation for experience-driven capability evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Evolver，一个以「探索到进化」原则为核心的经验驱动的智能体进化系统：将通过任务执行获得的知识转化为可持续的策略资产，以指导后续决策并支持迭代适应。 基于 Gene 表示，Evolver 将可复用的流程及其适用条件编码为结构化的 Gene 对象，通过 Capsule 将其与具体执行案例关联，并维护事件、来源与审查记录以支持经验管理。 通过与现有智能体框架集成，Evolver 使历史经验能够在后续任务执行中被调用，而无需修改底层模型参数。 Evolver 并不将执行历史视为被动记录，而是将流程性知识组织为可复用的资产，能够根据新的执行反馈进行选择、应用与维护。 这一设计建立了一种机制，使先前投入的探索能够贡献于未来的智能体行为，为经验驱动的能力进化奠定基础。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Evolver across two agent harnesses, Claude Code [ 4 ] and Codex [ 3 ] , two foundation model configurations, and four benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 2.1 [ 10 ] , SWE-bench Multilingual [ 11 ] , SWE-rebench [ 12 ] , and GAIA [ 13 ] . On a selected diagnostic set of 320 paired executions, Gene augmentation improves the overall task success rate from 83.13% to 87.50% (+4.38 percentage points), with gains observed under both Claude Code (+2.50 points) and Codex (+6.25 points). These improvements vary across models and benchmarks, with nine of the 16 evaluated configurations exhibiting higher task success. Beyond task effectiveness, Evolver reduces recorded task-execution token consumption by 24.24% overall. Notably, among 265 pairs that succeed both with and without Evolver , token consumption decreases by 17.57%, indicating that historical experience can improve execution efficiency even when task success is already achieved. Representative cases in terminal operations and software repair further illustrate these efficiency gains through fewer model invocations and lower token usage without compromising task success. Together, these findings highlight the complementary benefits of reusable procedural experience for task effectiveness and execution efficiency, positioning Evolver as a practical systems approach to transforming agent exploration into persistent, reusable capabilities without updating foundation model parameters.

paragraphs.en: Agent interactions generate procedural knowledge through exploration, tool use, and execution feedback, motivating approaches that reuse historical experience without updating model parameters. Early methods extract reusable insights from successful and failed trajectories [ 6 , 14 ] , while subsequent studies organize such knowledge into workflows, adaptive memory, and procedural guidance [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] . Complementary approaches package reusable procedures as executable skills or structured instructions [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] , whereas Agentic Plan Caching [ 22 ] reuses adaptable planning templates to reduce repeated computation. Recent studies further highlight that experience utility depends on representation quality and contextual applicability, as inappropriate skills may increase execution costs or degrade performance [ 23 , 24 ] .

paragraphs.en: Design Principles. Evolver follows the Exploration-to-Evolution principle, which transforms knowledge acquired through agent exploration into persistent strategy assets that can support future adaptation. This principle is realized through three complementary designs. First, Experience Externalization separates reusable procedural knowledge from individual execution trajectories, enabling its persistent representation and management. Second, Experience-Conditioned Execution makes relevant strategies available to existing agents without modifying their underlying model parameters or replacing their execution harnesses. Third, Feedback-Guided Evolution supports the assessment and maintenance of accumulated experience through execution feedback and lifecycle operations. Together, these designs establish a pathway for preserving the knowledge value of historical exploration and making it available to subsequent agent executions.
paragraphs.zh: 设计原则。 Evolver 遵循“从探索到进化”（Exploration-to-Evolution）原则，将通过智能体探索获得的知识转化为可持续的策略资产，以支持未来的适应。 该原则通过三项互补的设计来实现。 首先，经验外化（Experience Externalization）将可复用的程序性知识从个体执行轨迹中分离出来，使其能够被持久地表示和管理。 其次，经验条件化执行（Experience-Conditioned Execution）让现有智能体能够使用相关策略，而无需修改其底层模型参数或替换其执行框架。 第三，反馈引导的进化（Feedback-Guided Evolution）通过执行反馈和生命周期操作，支持对累积经验的评估与维护。 这些设计共同建立了一条路径，用于保留历史探索的知识价值，并使其可供后续的智能体执行使用。

paragraphs.en: System Architecture. As illustrated in Figure 1 , Evolver integrates experience acquisition, persistent asset management, retrieval, and feedback-supported evolution into a unified system. Historical agent interactions provide execution traces from which reusable strategies are extracted through signal analysis, automatic drafting, or optional model-based distillation. The resulting experience is organized into structured Gene objects, associated Capsule records, and supporting event, provenance, and review information. During subsequent tasks, relevant experience is retrieved and delivered through hooks, MCP interfaces, or host-specific integrations to condition agent behavior. Evolver further connects to EvoMap 1 1 1 https://evomap.ai/ for network-based experience publishing, discovery, and retrieval. Provenance tracking, review mechanisms, and execution safeguards provide operational controls whose enforcement depends on the integration pathway and deployment environment. The following sections detail these components and their roles in transforming historical exploration into reusable and evolving agent capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 系统架构。 如图1所示，Evolver 将经验获取、持久化资产管理、检索以及反馈支持的演化整合为一个统一系统。 历史智能体交互提供执行轨迹，通过信号分析、自动起草或可选的基于模型的提炼，从中提取可复用的策略。 所得到的经验被组织成结构化的 Gene 对象、关联的 Capsule 记录，以及配套的事件、来源和评审信息。 在后续任务中，通过钩子、MCP 接口或特定于宿主的集成来检索并传递相关经验，以调节智能体行为。 Evolver 还连接到 EvoMap 1 1 1 https://evomap.ai/，用于基于网络的经验发布、发现与检索。 来源追踪、评审机制和执行保障提供了运营控制，其执行程度取决于集成路径与部署环境。 以下各节将详细介绍这些组件及其在将历史探索转化为可复用且不断演化的智能体能力方面所起的作用。

paragraphs.en: Persistent Asset Management. Evolver maintains experience assets through content-addressed, append-only storage, preserving asset identity independently of subsequent lifecycle decisions. Review and provenance states are maintained in separate records, supporting experience quarantine, approval, rejection, and revocation without overwriting the underlying assets. This separation enables persistent procedural knowledge to coexist with evolving eligibility and trust states, providing a foundation for feedback-driven experience management. The enforcement of these states depends on the corresponding acquisition and retrieval pathways, as detailed in Sections 3.3 , 3.4 and 3.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 持久的资产管理。 Evolver 通过内容寻址的只追加存储维护经验资产，使资产身份独立于后续生命周期决策而得以保留。 审核与溯源状态维护在单独的记录中，支持对经验进行隔离、批准、拒绝和撤销，而不会覆写底层资产。 这种分离使持久的程序性知识能够与不断演变的可用性和信任状态共存，为反馈驱动的经验管理提供了基础。 这些状态的执行取决于相应的获取与检索路径，详见第 3.3、3.4 和 3.5 节。

sents.en: Review and provenance states are maintained in separate records, supporting experience quarantine, approval, rejection, and revocation without overwriting the underlying assets.
sents.zh: 审核与溯源状态维护在单独的记录中，支持对经验进行隔离、批准、拒绝和撤销，而不会覆写底层资产。

sents.en: This separation enables persistent procedural knowledge to coexist with evolving eligibility and trust states, providing a foundation for feedback-driven experience management.
sents.zh: 这种分离使持久的程序性知识能够与不断演变的可用性和信任状态共存，为反馈驱动的经验管理提供了基础。

sents.en: The enforcement of these states depends on the corresponding acquisition and retrieval pathways, as detailed in Sections 3.3 , 3.4 and 3.5 .
sents.zh: 这些状态的执行取决于相应的获取与检索路径，详见第 3.3、3.4 和 3.5 节。

paragraphs.en: Experience Sources. Evolver treats historical agent interactions as a source of reusable procedural knowledge, capturing not only task outcomes but also the exploration and feedback that precede them. When session ingestion is enabled, runtime adapters collect records from supported agent harnesses, including task context, tool interactions, execution errors, and available outcomes. These records are normalized into bounded experience materials with heuristic sensitive-information redaction. Additional experience can be acquired through explicit asset submissions and external experience repositories, providing complementary sources beyond automatically collected sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 经验来源。 Evolver 将历史智能体交互视为可复用程序性知识的来源，不仅捕获任务结果，还捕获先于结果的探索与反馈。 启用会话摄取后，运行时适配器会从受支持的智能体框架中收集记录，包括任务上下文、工具交互、执行错误以及可用的结果。 这些记录会被规范化为有界的经验材料，并通过启发式方法脱敏敏感信息。 额外的经验可以通过显式资产提交和外部经验仓库获取，从而提供自动收集的会话之外的补充来源。

paragraphs.en: Experience Extraction. Given collected experience materials, Evolver identifies lightweight signals associated with successful execution, failures, and task difficulty to construct candidate Gene objects. The default automated drafting pathway extracts concise procedural hints from assistant utterances and marks them as unproven, rather than assuming that the resulting strategies have been validated. When enabled, LLM-based distillation further supports structured experience extraction from execution records, including reusable strategies, associated cases, and negative procedural guidance. These complementary pathways separate low-cost experience collection from more structured synthesis, while leaving the effectiveness of generated strategies subject to subsequent evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 经验提取。 给定收集到的经验材料，Evolver 识别与成功执行、失败和任务难度相关的轻量级信号，以构建候选的 Gene 对象。 默认的自动化起草路径从助手话语中提取简洁的程序性提示，并将其标记为未经证实，而不是假定由此产生的策略已经过验证。 启用后，基于大语言模型的蒸馏进一步支持从执行记录中进行结构化经验提取，包括可复用策略、相关案例以及负面程序性指导。 这些互补的路径将低成本的经验收集与更结构化的综合区分开来，同时使所生成策略的有效性留待后续评估。

paragraphs.en: Experience Consolidation. Extracted experience is consolidated into persistent, content-addressed assets, with supporting execution cases retained when available. Automatically drafted and model-distilled candidates are placed under review, whereas certain explicit submission pathways can persist assets directly. Review and provenance records maintain experience eligibility and source information separately from the underlying strategy content, although admission and trust enforcement depend on the acquisition and retrieval pathways. By preserving candidate knowledge independently of its current lifecycle state, Evolver establishes a reusable experience base that supports subsequent retrieval and feedback-guided evolution, as detailed in Sections 3.4 and 3.5 .

paragraphs.en: Task-Conditioned Experience Retrieval. To reuse historical knowledge, Evolver provides multiple retrieval pathways that select experience according to task context and integration requirements. Session-start hooks supply a bounded set of locally eligible Gene objects, while optional prompt-time recall matches task descriptions against stored experience signals. MCP interfaces additionally support on-demand experience retrieval, whereas autonomous execution employs a separate heuristic selection mechanism incorporating task relevance, experience quality, and historical reuse feedback. These pathways differ in their ranking strategies, context budgets, and eligibility checks, allowing experience delivery to accommodate different execution settings.
paragraphs.zh: 任务条件化的经验检索。 为了复用历史知识，Evolver 提供了多种检索路径，可根据任务上下文和集成需求来选择经验。 会话启动钩子提供一组数量有限且本地可用的 Gene 对象，而可选的提示期召回则将任务描述与存储的经验信号进行匹配。 MCP 接口还支持按需的经验检索，而自主执行则采用一种独立的启发式选择机制，该机制综合考量任务相关性、经验质量和历史复用反馈。 这些路径在排序策略、上下文预算和可用性检查方面各不相同，使经验的交付能够适应不同的执行场景。

paragraphs.en: Experience-Conditioned Execution. Retrieved Gene objects, together with associated Capsule examples when available, are delivered through session hooks, prompt-time injection, MCP tools, or host-specific integrations. Rather than modifying foundation model parameters or replacing agent execution policies, Evolver introduces procedural guidance into the existing interaction context, enabling the host agent to interpret and apply historical strategies. This separation between experience management and task execution allows Evolver to augment existing agent harnesses while preserving their native reasoning, tool-use, and verification capabilities. Consequently, historical exploration can inform subsequent decisions without requiring additional model training or modifications to the underlying agent architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 经验条件化执行。 检索到的 Gene 对象，以及（在可用时）相关联的 Capsule 示例，通过会话钩子、提示时注入、MCP 工具或特定于宿主的集成来交付。 Evolver 不修改基础模型参数，也不替换智能体执行策略，而是将程序性引导引入现有的交互上下文，使宿主智能体能够解释和应用历史策略。 这种经验管理与任务执行之间的分离，使 Evolver 能够增强现有的智能体框架，同时保留其原生的推理、工具使用和验证能力。 因此，历史探索可以为后续决策提供依据，而无需额外的模型训练或对底层智能体架构进行修改。

paragraphs.en: Networked Experience through EvoMap. Beyond local experience reuse, Evolver integrates with EvoMap to support the publication, discovery, and retrieval of experience assets across connected agents. This interface extends the available knowledge beyond individual execution histories, allowing agents to access strategies contributed by other nodes. External assets can be associated with provenance and trust metadata, although direct retrieval and locally imported assets follow different admission and review pathways. Together, local and network-based experience access provides a foundation for broader experience reuse.
paragraphs.zh: 通过 EvoMap 实现网络化体验。 除了本地体验复用之外，Evolver 还与 EvoMap 集成，以支持在相连的智能体之间发布、发现和检索体验资产。 该接口将可用知识扩展到个体执行历史之外，使智能体能够访问由其他节点贡献的策略。 外部资产可以关联来源和信任元数据，不过直接检索的资产与本地导入的资产遵循不同的准入与审查路径。 本地与基于网络的体验访问共同为更广泛的体验复用提供了基础。

paragraphs.en: Execution Feedback. Beyond preserving and reusing historical knowledge, Evolver supports experience evolution through feedback collected from subsequent executions. Depending on the execution pathway, feedback includes task outcomes, validation results, reuse events, and interaction signals from agent hosts. Autonomous execution evaluates task outcomes using execution status and available verification procedures, while host integrations can report observed checks and reuse-related signals. These observations provide a basis for experience assessment.

paragraphs.en: Experience Lifecycle. Rather than treating accumulated experience as permanently applicable, Evolver maintains lifecycle states that govern how strategies are retained and reused. Automatically drafted and model-distilled Gene candidates initially enter quarantine and can subsequently be approved or rejected through review. An optional probation mechanism further supports promotion based on recorded successes and failures, while autonomous execution incorporates historical reuse signals and failure-based restrictions into candidate selection. Rejection and provenance revocation are recorded separately from the underlying content-addressed assets, preserving their identity while modifying their subsequent eligibility. These mechanisms instantiate the lifecycle operations underlying 𝒰 \mathcal{U} in Equation 1 , allowing experience states to evolve without modifying foundation model parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 经验生命周期。 Evolver 不将累积的经验视为永久适用，而是维护若干生命周期状态，以控制策略的保留与复用方式。 自动起草的基因候选与模型蒸馏的基因候选最初进入隔离状态，随后可通过审核被批准或拒绝。 可选的试用期机制进一步支持依据记录的成功与失败进行晋升，同时自主执行会将历史复用信号与基于失败的限制纳入候选选择。 拒绝与来源撤销的记录与底层的内容寻址资产分开保存，从而在保留其身份的同时修改其后续的可用资格。 这些机制实现了公式 1 中 𝒰 \mathcal{U} 所依赖的生命周期操作，使经验状态无需修改基础模型参数即可演化。

paragraphs.en: Trust-Aware Evolution. Because experience may originate from local execution or external contributors, Evolver associates assets with provenance and review information to support source-aware management. Imported EvoMap assets can be marked as untrusted until explicitly promoted, while supported execution pathways apply additional validation and operational safeguards. However, admission checks and trust enforcement are pathway-dependent, and some direct retrieval interfaces do not apply the same restrictions. Together, these mechanisms provide a foundation for feedback-guided experience adaptation, distinguishing the evolution of reusable strategy states from an assumption of uniformly improving agent performance.

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks and Agent Configurations. We evaluate Evolver on four benchmarks covering diverse agent capabilities: Terminal-Bench 2.1 [ 10 ] , SWE-bench Multilingual [ 11 ] , SWE-rebench [ 12 ] , and GAIA [ 13 ] . Terminal-Bench 2.1 evaluates terminal-based engineering tasks, SWE-bench Multilingual and SWE-rebench assess software issue resolution, and GAIA examines multi-step information seeking and reasoning. We consider two agent harnesses, Claude Code and Codex, each paired with two foundation model configurations, deepseek-v4.1-flash [ 32 ] and gpt-5.6-sol [ 33 ] . For each benchmark, we prioritize the first 20 tasks in their original order. Tasks yielding empty responses due to malformed outputs, timeouts, or execution failures are replaced sequentially with subsequent tasks. We ensure that all harness–model configurations are evaluated on the same 20 tasks per benchmark, yielding 16 configurations in total. All experiments use Evolver v2.0.33.

paragraphs.en: Experience Construction and Paired Evaluation. We adopt a three-stage Baseline–Extraction–Gene (B–E–G) protocol to examine the effects of historical experience reuse. In the Baseline Execution (B) stage, each agent executes the original task using its native tools and built-in skills without additional Gene injection. In the Experience Extraction (E) stage, reusable strategies are distilled from valid baseline trajectories, including both successful and unsuccessful executions, using a model configuration matched to the corresponding evaluation setting. Experience pools are isolated by evaluation batch, benchmark, harness, and model, and candidate assets are frozen before augmented execution. In the Gene-Augmented Execution (G) stage, the agent receives the original task together with selected Gene guidance in a fresh session with the task environment restored. Gene selection prioritizes experience derived from the same task, followed by other matching candidates within the isolated pool, with an injection budget of 12,000 bytes. Both B and G retain the same foundation model and harness configuration and are evaluated using the corresponding native benchmark grader. This protocol assesses historical experience reuse rather than generalization to unseen tasks or long-term online evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 经验构建与配对评估。 我们采用三阶段的基线–提取–基因（B–E–G）协议来检验历史经验复用的效果。 在基线执行（B）阶段，每个智能体使用其原生工具和内置技能执行原始任务，不注入额外的基因。 在经验提取（E）阶段，使用与对应评估设置相匹配的模型配置，从有效的基线轨迹（包括成功和失败的执行）中提炼可复用的策略。 经验池按评估批次、基准、执行框架和模型进行隔离，候选资产在增强执行之前被冻结。 在基因增强执行（G）阶段，智能体在全新的会话中接收原始任务以及选定的基因引导，并恢复任务环境。 基因选择优先使用来自同一任务的经验，其次是隔离池内其他匹配的候选经验，注入预算为 12,000 字节。 B 和 G 两个阶段都保留相同的基础模型和执行框架配置，并使用对应的原生基准评分器进行评估。 该协议评估的是历史经验复用，而非对未见任务的泛化或长期在线演化。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Criteria and Metrics. We analyze 320 paired observations, retaining 20 tasks per configuration with valid outcomes and complete token records for both B and G, excluding executions interrupted by timeouts or token limits. The final task selection additionally considers observed outcome improvements and token usage, making the resulting set diagnostic rather than a random sample of the full benchmarks. We report task success rates and percentage-point differences, together with recorded task-execution tokens and model invocation counts. Aggregate token reduction is computed from total usage across paired executions rather than averaging individual reduction ratios. We further analyze pairs that succeed under both conditions to assess resource changes while preserving task success. Token accounting includes recorded model input and output usage but excludes experience extraction and other overhead outside the final task executions.
paragraphs.zh: 评估标准与指标。 我们分析了320组配对观测，每个配置保留20个具有有效结果且同时拥有B和G完整token记录的任务，排除因超时或token上限而中断的执行。 最终的任务选择还考虑了观测到的结果改进和token使用情况，因此所得集合具有诊断性质，而非完整基准的随机样本。 我们报告任务成功率和百分点差异，同时报告记录的任务执行token用量和模型调用次数。 总体token缩减量是根据配对执行的总用量计算的，而不是对单个缩减比例取平均。 我们进一步分析在两种条件下都成功的配对，以在保持任务成功的前提下评估资源变化。 Token统计包含记录的模型输入和输出用量，但不包括经验提取以及最终任务执行之外的其他开销。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced Evolver , a framework for transforming transient agent exploration into persistent, reusable procedural experience. By integrating structured Gene representation, experience acquisition, retrieval, and feedback-guided evolution, Evolver enables existing agent harnesses to reuse accumulated knowledge without modifying foundation model parameters. Across two agent harnesses, two foundation model configurations, and four benchmarks, our selected diagnostic evaluation shows that experience reuse improves task success by 4.38 percentage points while reducing recorded task-execution token consumption by 24.24%. Notably, token consumption decreases by 17.57% among tasks successfully completed under both conditions, suggesting that reusable experience can improve execution efficiency even when task success remains unchanged. These findings highlight the complementary roles of accumulated procedural knowledge in improving task effectiveness and reducing redundant execution effort. Future work will investigate more reliable experience selection and validation, transfer to unseen tasks, and longitudinal evolution of reusable capabilities. More broadly, Evolver provides a systems foundation for turning isolated agent interactions into persistent knowledge that can support continued capability improvement.
